```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/00_config.R")
cgroup_mem_mb <- function() {        # memory limit of the cgroup this R process is in
  d <- file.path("/sys/fs/cgroup", sub("^0::", "", readLines("/proc/self/cgroup")[1]))
  while (nchar(d) > nchar("/sys/fs/cgroup")) {
    f <- file.path(d, "memory.max")
    if (file.exists(f) && readLines(f) != "max") return(as.numeric(readLines(f)) / 2^20)
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  NA_real_
}
```

## The results: computed elsewhere, just read here

The heavy lifting happened in `R/04_launch_slurm.R` (2,000 tasks on 8 SLURM daemons).
The report only reads the saved result, so rendering takes seconds:

```{r}
hr <- readRDS("results/site_hazard_ratios.rds")
head(hr[order(hr$hr), c("site", "n", "hr", "hr_lower", "hr_upper", "n_boot")])
```

## Where is this document being rendered?

```{r}
here <- data.frame(
  mode            = params$mode,
  host            = Sys.info()[["nodename"]],
  slurm_job       = Sys.getenv("SLURM_JOB_ID", NA),
  job_cpus        = Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_ON_NODE", NA),
  available_cores = unname(parallelly::availableCores()),
  detect_cores    = parallel::detectCores(),
  mem_limit_mb    = cgroup_mem_mb()
)
here
```

## And where do the parallel tasks run?

8 tasks of ~1 s CPU each, with `future_map()`:

```{r}
cohort <- readRDS("data/cohort.rds")
one_site <- cohort[cohort$site == "site_01", ]

if (isTRUE(params$slurm_daemons)) {
  # daemons as SLURM jobs, sized from the profile; this R process only orchestrates
  start_daemons(4, readRDS("results/resources.rds"), use_slurm = TRUE,
                partition = SLURM_PARTITION, rscript = RSCRIPT)
  future::plan(future.mirai::mirai_cluster)
} else {
  # workers inside *this* allocation, as many as it allows
  future::plan(future::multisession, workers = parallelly::availableCores())
}

t <- system.time(
  where <- furrr::future_map_chr(1:8, function(i) {
    bootstrap_site(one_site, n_boot = 50)
    Sys.info()[["nodename"]]
  }, .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE, globals = c("bootstrap_site", "one_site")))
)[["elapsed"]]
here$workers <- future::nbrOfWorkers()
future::plan(future::sequential)
if (isTRUE(params$slurm_daemons)) mirai::daemons(0)

here$worker_hosts <- length(unique(where))
here$tasks_s      <- round(t, 1)
here[c("mode", "available_cores", "worker_hosts", "tasks_s")]
```

```{r}
#| include: false
csv <- "results/quarto_modes.csv"
write.table(here, csv, sep = ",", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = !file.exists(csv), append = file.exists(csv))
```
